explainer_content.short_definition: West Coast street rap and G-funk: confrontational stories, slow funk grooves, and cinematic rap personas.
explainer_content.history_capsule: The lane rises from late-1980s Los Angeles rap into early-1990s G-funk, turning local street narratives and funk sampling into national hip-hop language.
explainer_content.why_it_mattered: It changed rap's commercial center, controversy level, production vocabulary, and image of West Coast hip-hop.
explainer_content.what_made_it_distinct: The mood is dangerous and relaxed at once: hard stories over smooth, rubbery funk.
